name: CephCluster
description: Rook CephCluster Custom Resource for declaratively managing Ceph storage clusters on Kubernetes

fields.name: cephVersion
fields.description: Ceph container image version to deploy

fields.name: dataDirHostPath
fields.description: Host path for storing Ceph configuration and data

fields.name: storage
fields.description: Storage scope defining which nodes and devices to use

fields.name: network
fields.description: Network configuration for Ceph cluster communication

fields.name: placement
fields.description: Node placement rules for Ceph daemons

fields.name: resources
fields.description: CPU and memory resource requests and limits for daemons

fields.name: status
fields.description: CephCluster runtime status reported by the Rook operator

fields.name: ceph
fields.description: Ceph cluster health and version details
